output.title: AWS Route53 DNS deletion error fix; verify Route53 usage
output.content: The upgrade includes a bug fix for AWS Route53 error detection during DNS record deletion. Your environment runs cert-manager v1.17.0 with cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate CRD installed. The fix applies only if you use Route53 as a DNS provider for cert-manager ACME challenges. Inspect your cert-manager issuer/clusterissuer configuration and values to confirm whether you have Route53 DNS01 solver definitions; if you do, this fix may prevent spurious errors during certificate cleanup.
